## Observed — ONGOING PRODUCTION OUTAGE

Every `docker compose build` on the rebar-gerrit host fails at the `uv sync` layer:

    #16 [mcp stage-0 7/8] RUN uv sync --locked --no-dev --extra agents --extra mcp --extra bedrock
    #16 0.304 error: Required uv version `==0.12.7` does not match the running version `0.12.9`
    failed to solve: ... exit code: 2

Captured from `journalctl -u rebar-autodeploy` on i-00880b2c7f13527c5 at 2026-09-03 05:02 and 05:06 UTC. The failure repeats every autodeploy tick, escalating the backoff (fail#3 240s, fail#4 480s), and `rebar-autodeploy.service` reports 'Failed with result exit-code' each time.

## Root cause — an exact pin against a floating tag

`pyproject.toml:346` declares `required-version = "==0.12.7"`, added by commit `7501cc1d602d` ('Pin uv once so CI stops resolving it remotely'). uv reads `required-version` itself and fails fast when the running binary differs.

But the container builds do NOT install a pinned uv. All three copy from a FLOATING tag:

- `infra/compose/Dockerfile.mcp:90`
- `infra/compose/Dockerfile.reviewbot:112`
- `infra/compose/Dockerfile.opcert:37`

each `COPY --from=ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:latest /uv /usr/local/bin/uv`.

`:latest` has since moved to 0.12.9, so the pin and the binary disagree and every build dies. The CI path was fixed by the same pin commit via `.github/actions/setup-uv/action.yml`, which DOES pin a version — the three Dockerfiles were left behind. This is a time bomb by construction: it fires whenever upstream publishes, with no change to this repo.

## Blast radius — wider than it currently looks

MCP is the only VISIBLY broken service because its container is separately dead (OOM-killed, see `9ea3-7d07-ea55-4496`) and therefore needs a rebuild it can never complete. The review-bot and opcert containers are still serving their last-known-good images, so they LOOK healthy — but their builds are equally broken, and any restart, host reboot, or deploy touching them turns this into a second outage. The box is currently not tracking main at all.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] AC1: container builds no longer resolve uv from a floating tag. All three Dockerfiles pull a uv whose version satisfies `required-version` in pyproject.toml. Verified by a successful `docker compose build` of each.
- [x] AC2: the pinned uv version is SINGLE-SOURCED, not copied into four places. A drift between `pyproject.toml`'s `required-version` and what the images install must be impossible-by-construction or caught by a gate, not left to review. Verified by changing the pin and observing the gate or build fail.
- [x] AC3: a test or CI gate fails when any Dockerfile references a floating `:latest` tag for a version-sensitive toolchain image. Verified by adding `:latest` back to one Dockerfile and seeing it fail.
- [x] AC4 [non-codebase]: the box is confirmed tracking main again — `rebar-autodeploy` completes a deploy and `deployed-sha` advances to current origin/main.

## Testing

- `docker compose -f infra/compose/docker-compose.yml build mcp reviewbot opcert`
- the AC3 gate test
- post-fix: `journalctl -u rebar-autodeploy` shows a clean cutover

## Completion evidence (2026-09-03)

- **AC1** — the three Dockerfiles now pull `ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:0.12.7`. `docker build -f infra/compose/Dockerfile.opcert` exits 0 and `docker run --entrypoint uv` reports `uv 0.12.7 (aarch64-unknown-linux-musl)`; the pre-fix build with `:latest --no-cache` reproduced the production error verbatim.
- **AC2** — single-sourced against `pyproject.toml`'s `[tool.uv] required-version` by extending the EXISTING gate `scripts/check_uv_pin.py` (already in `make lint` and pre-commit) rather than adding a second source of truth. Reintroducing a skewed tag fails the gate naming both versions.
- **AC3** — `tests/unit/test_uv_pin_guard.py`, 36 tests. Assertions bind to `path:line: <specific finding>`; proven under a detection-disabling mutant, where the earlier trailer-text assertions still passed and the new ones fail. Also covers the `FROM --platform=` and ARG-template escapes found during review.
- **AC4** — box confirmed tracking main. Last FAILED deploy `4a5a95531ee5` (fail #5) still had `uv:latest`; first SUCCESSFUL deploy `3e04025b684e` has `uv:0.12.7`. Journal 06:41:01: `mcp cutover complete: /mcp upstream now 127.0.0.1:8092 (deploy DONE)`. On-box: `docker ps` shows `rebar-mcp-3e04025b684e-8092 Up (healthy)` and `/etc/nginx/mcp-upstream.conf` names that live port. Externally `/mcp` returns 401 (auth required) instead of 502.

Carry-over, unchanged and out of scope: `docker-compose.langfuse.yml:113` still runs `minio:latest` — same defect class, a compose `image:` key rather than a Dockerfile, awaiting an operator decision on the version to pin.
